entries.2b609b84bed19025: From April 2023, it has pursued the 'Medium-Term Management Plan 23-25,' with five basic strategies: strengthening core businesses, expanding business domains, reducing environmental impact, rebuilding its platform, and strengthening stakeholder engagement. entries.390526498419bc42: The company manufactures and sells wheat flour and premix. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥103,600 million. Okumoto Seifun Co., Ltd., Kida Seifun Co., Ltd., Naigai Seifun Co., Ltd. and Central Seifun Co., Ltd. produce wheat flour, Showa Sangyo International Vietnam Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells premix in Vietnam, and Shosan Shoji Co., Ltd. sells the company's products. Breads for convenience stores are produced by Swing Bakery Co., Ltd., Gran Sol Bakery Co., Ltd., Garden Bakery Co., Ltd. and Tower Bakery Co., Ltd.
